sn34.12:1.4: na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ
sn34.12:1.5: samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca. tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī
sn34.12:1.6: samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca
sn34.12:1.7: seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā
